add_solution_bluetooth_adapter:
1. Open Windows Settings > Devices > Bluetooth & other devices and make sure Bluetooth is on.
2. If Bluetooth is already on, turn it off and back on.
3. Disable and re-enable the Bluetooth adapter in Device Manager, or update its driver.
4. If no Bluetooth adapter is installed, connect one that supports Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE).
add_solution_bluetooth_access:
1. Make sure Bluetooth has not been disabled by an organization policy.
2. Check Windows privacy and Bluetooth permission settings.
3. Restart the Windows Bluetooth Support Service or restart the PC, then try again.
add_solution_scan_timeout:
1. Power the controller completely off.
2. Start scanning, then press and hold the pairing button until the connection succeeds.
3. Keep the controller close to the PC and make sure it is charged.
4. After repeated failures, wait a few minutes for the controller's connection cooldown to end.
add_solution_device_unavailable:
1. Keep holding the pairing button so the controller continues advertising.
2. Keep the controller close to the PC and make sure it is charged.
3. Remove any old controller pairing from Windows Bluetooth settings, then try again.
add_solution_gatt_unreachable:
1. Power the controller off, start a new scan, and keep holding the pairing button.
2. Start scanning, then press and hold the pairing button until the connection succeeds.
3. After repeated failures, wait a few minutes in case the controller is in connection cooldown.
add_solution_gatt_access:
1. Remove the controller's old pairing from Windows Bluetooth settings.
2. Re-enable the Bluetooth adapter and pair again.
3. Check system Bluetooth permissions and organization policies.
add_solution_notification:
1. Keep the controller close to the PC and make sure it is charged.
2. Power it off, scan again, and keep holding the pairing button.
3. Remove any old Windows pairing or re-enable the Bluetooth adapter, then try again.
add_solution_virtual_controller:
1. Make sure ViGEmBus is installed, then restart the PC.
2. Repair or reinstall ViGEmBus if it is already installed.
3. Close other virtual-controller applications and restart this app.
4. For NoFreeSlot errors, disconnect virtual controllers that are no longer used.
